system_texts: Ambiguity about product scope: universal remote vs TV remote.
Feasibility: the proposed price around 25 EUR may be too high given production cost of 12.5 EUR.
There is a tight timeline to get the product to market.
gold_texts: There was a misunderstanding about the target user group that forced the group to reevaluate their decisions on several components once they received the correct information.
The new requirement that the remote was only to control television forced the group to change some of their initial design ideas.
The group did not reach a decision on how to ensure that the remote would recognize all brands of televisions.
